agent_priors_used: Benchmark arms whose correctness is already at ceiling cannot establish a treatment advantage; dynamic range must be certified on the comparator before spending an expensive run (agent prior; consistent with the recorded bounded substrate-class negative EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440, not independently re-established here).

For small, well-structured binding vocabularies a deterministic lexical resolver with an explicit abstention signal can match or beat learned embeddings, and calibrated selective abstention - not raw selection accuracy - is usually the binding constraint for safe deployment (agent prior).

A bounded positive from a single vantage/condition should be re-tested on the orthogonal axis (independent source vantage) before being treated as a general property; if that orthogonal axis is unavailable, the result keeps its declared scope boundary (agent prior).

Long-horizon agents are generally more robust when they persist procedures/mechanisms and re-observe volatile values than when they persist exact state, because transport- and context-coupled values drift faster than mechanisms (agent prior; SPIDER's value-persistence negative is consistent with but does not prove this).

A capable model runtime is a prerequisite that cannot be discovered by re-running benchmark arms; the correct first step is a minimal capability probe, and if none can be provisioned the blocker must be recorded as an exact operational receipt rather than substituted (agent prior).

A both-directions falsifier that can return a clean bounded negative is worth more than another positive refinement; re-running the same sampling-frame precondition without changing the measured object is a design defect being repeated, not a second experiment (agent prior).

allocation.rationale: Product's pre-freeze experiment EXP-PRODUCT-38170378449 is exactly the audit's top blocker B1: the shipped src/spider/kernel.py still has no distill_parameterized (verified literal at last global-audit source check), so the flagship benchmark has no treatment arm and reviewers must not be served another mechanism-in-a-lane-branch. Decision counterfactual: certificate PASS + independent audit PASS -> promotion of the parameterized carrier to the shipping kernel is enabled and readiness condition (1) is discharged; FAIL/REVISE -> promotion is refused and the shipped kernel remains literal, so the flagship four-arm benchmark cannot honestly run. Either branch changes whether the flagship economics question may be asked at all, which is why this continues and does not drift into a new research question. Feasibility is high: the carrier itself is already audited live on a real credential-free substrate (EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064, audit PASS), so this is an installation + binding-certificate + identity-pinning gate, not a new mechanism search. Scope discipline: this is the promotion gate only; the full C-LLM-INHERIT four-arm benchmark remains unfunded until readiness conditions (2) and (3) also hold. Smallest decisive batch: one frozen positive/negative certificate at the shipping path; stop trigger: if the carrier cannot be installed byte-identically or the certificate fails, record the exact promotion blocker and do not re-run the certificate against a substituted carrier.
